homeTagline: Every mission leaves a story behind.

conclusion.title: THE LEGACY CONTINUES
conclusion.body:
Every space mission tells a story.

Some spacecraft returned to Earth. Others remained on the Moon, on Mars, or continued traveling through space after fulfilling their purpose.

But none of them should be forgotten.

Every instrument, every vehicle, and every discovery represents the effort of people who dared to explore the unknown.

Although many of these machines no longer work, their legacy lives on through the knowledge they gave us and the future generations who will continue exploring.

Space exploration does not end when a mission goes silent.

One chapter ends, but another begins.

Because the universe still holds millions of stories waiting to be discovered.

phrases: Somewhere in the universe, a signal fell silent.
A mission reached the end of its journey.
But its story did not disappear.
On the Moon, on Mars, and beyond, traces of our curiosity remain.
Every instrument helped us understand the universe a little better.
And every discovery opened the way for the next.
Missions may come to an end.
The universe still holds stories waiting to be discovered.
And the next exploration could begin with you.
